data.body: Duplicate of 74a3-1213-9898-4195, which a concurrent agent is already landing via Gerrit change 1382 (patch set 1 uploaded, CI running) with the SAME fix: extract the completion-precheck cluster (_is_live_ticket/_has_live_replacement_link/_referencing_commit_exists/_completion_precheck) into a new sibling module along the existing call-graph seam. Deferring to 74a3 to avoid a redundant change and a guaranteed merge conflict on the same new file. My local implementation (worktree split-transition-close-ce14) is retained as a fallback should 1382 fail to land; e34a's blocker was retargeted from ce14 onto 74a3. Closing ce14 as duplicate.
